<span class="normal">515</span></pre></div></td><td class="code"><div><pre><span></span><span class="sd">/// Follow/unfollow handlers, follower/following lists, and the private-</span>
<span class="sd">/// account follow-request flow (request -&gt; accept/reject -&gt; actual follow).</span>

<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">axum</span><span class="p">::{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">extract</span><span class="p">::{</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">http</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">serde</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Serialize</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">uuid</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">AuthUser</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">errors</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">handlers</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">handlers</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">blocks</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">check_block</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">handlers</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">notifications</span><span class="p">::{</span><span class="n">publish_notification</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">NotificationEvent</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">NotificationResponse</span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">models</span><span class="p">::{</span><span class="n">FollowRequestResponse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">UserResponse</span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="k">use</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">utils</span><span class="p">::{</span><span class="n">DbResultExt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ResolveMedia</span><span class="p">};</span>

<span class="sd">/// Response for follow/unfollow actions</span>
<span class="cp">#[derive(Serialize)]</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">FollowResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">String</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">/// "following" if this call resulted in an actual (accepted) follow,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">/// "requested" if it went to a private account and is now pending.</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">String</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// Profile stats — returned with user profiles</span>
<span class="cp">#[derive(Serialize)]</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">ProfileStats</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">followers</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">i64</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">following</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">i64</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">posts</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">i64</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// Whether `follower_id` actively (accepted-ly) follows `following_id`.</span>
<span class="sd">/// Shared by the post-visibility gate in posts.rs and the profile</span>
<span class="sd">/// relationship lookup in users.rs.</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">is_following</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kp">&amp;</span><span class="nc">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">PgPool</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">following_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM follows WHERE follower_id = $1 AND following_id = $2)"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">following_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_one</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// Whether `requester_id` has a pending (not yet accepted/rejected)</span>
<span class="sd">/// follow request to `target_id`.</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">has_pending_follow_request</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kp">&amp;</span><span class="nc">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">PgPool</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM follow_requests WHERE requester_id = $1 AND target_id = $2)"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_one</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// Actually establish a follow (counters + feed backfill + notification),</span>
<span class="sd">/// shared between a direct follow of a public account and accepting a</span>
<span class="sd">/// pending request to a private one. Assumes the caller has already</span>
<span class="sd">/// decided this follow should happen -- doesn't check is_private itself.</span>
<span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">establish_follow</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kp">&amp;</span><span class="nc">AppState</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Uuid</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">begin</span><span class="p">().</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to start transaction"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">newly_followed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING follower_id"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to follow user"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">is_some</span><span class="p">();</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">pending_notification</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Option</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">NotificationEvent</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">newly_followed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"UPDATE users SET following_count = following_count + 1 WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to update following_count"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"UPDATE users SET follower_count = follower_count + 1 WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to update follower_count"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="s">r#"</span>
<span class="s">            INSERT INTO feed_items (user_id, post_id, created_at)</span>
<span class="s">            SELECT $1, id, created_at FROM posts WHERE user_id = $2</span>
<span class="s">            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING</span>
<span class="s">            "#</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to backfill feed_items on follow"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="s">"INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, type)</span>
<span class="s">             VALUES ($1, $2, 'follow'::notification_type)</span>
<span class="s">             ON CONFLICT (user_id, actor_id, type, COALESCE(post_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'), COALESCE(comment_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))</span>
<span class="s">             DO NOTHING RETURNING id"</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">unwrap_or_default</span><span class="p">();</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Some</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_as</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">models</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">UserRow</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">follower_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">fetch_one</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">pending_notification</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Some</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">NotificationEvent</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">target_user_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">target_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">notification</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">NotificationResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">nid</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">type_name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"follow"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">is_read</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">created_at</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">chrono</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Utc</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">now</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">post_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">post_thumb_url</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                        </span><span class="n">actor</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">UserResponse</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">from</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="p">});</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">commit</span><span class="p">().</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to commit transaction"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Some</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">pending_notification</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">publish_notification</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(())</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// POST /users/:username/follow — follow a user, or request to (auth required)</span>
<span class="sd">///</span>
<span class="sd">/// For a public account: identical to before -- establishes the follow</span>
<span class="sd">/// immediately (counters, feed backfill, 'follow' notification).</span>
<span class="sd">/// For a private account: creates a pending follow_requests row instead</span>
<span class="sd">/// and notifies the target with a 'follow_request' notification; no</span>
<span class="sd">/// counters or feed access until they accept.</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">follow_user</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">State</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">AuthUser</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Path</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nb">String</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">FollowResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Not routed through utils::find_user_id_by_username: this lookup also</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// needs is_private, which that helper doesn't fetch.</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_as</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"SELECT id, is_private FROM users WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER($1)"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">ok_or_else</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">not_found</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="fm">format!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"User '{}' not found"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">)))</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target_is_private</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">==</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">bad_request</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"You can't follow yourself"</span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">check_block</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">bad_request</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Cannot follow this user"</span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n">target_is_private</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">establish_follow</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">tracing</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">info</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"User {} followed {}"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">((</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">CREATED</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">FollowResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">format</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Now following {}"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"following"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Private account: create a pending request instead. ON CONFLICT DO</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// NOTHING makes re-requesting a no-op rather than erroring or</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// duplicating the notification.</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">r#"</span>
<span class="s">        WITH inserted AS (</span>
<span class="s">            INSERT INTO follow_requests (requester_id, target_id)</span>
<span class="s">            VALUES ($1, $2)</span>
<span class="s">            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING</span>
<span class="s">            RETURNING requester_id</span>
<span class="s">        )</span>
<span class="s">        INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, type)</span>
<span class="s">        SELECT $2, $1, 'follow_request'::notification_type</span>
<span class="s">        FROM inserted</span>
<span class="s">        ON CONFLICT (user_id, actor_id, type, COALESCE(post_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'), COALESCE(comment_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))</span>
<span class="s">        DO NOTHING</span>
<span class="s">        RETURNING id</span>
<span class="s">        "#</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">unwrap_or_default</span><span class="p">();</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Some</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_as</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">models</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">UserRow</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">fetch_one</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">event</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">NotificationEvent</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">target_user_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">target_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">notification</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">NotificationResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">nid</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">type_name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"follow_request"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">is_read</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">created_at</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">chrono</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Utc</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">now</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">post_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">post_thumb_url</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">actor</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">UserResponse</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">from</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">publish_notification</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">((</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">ACCEPTED</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">FollowResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">format</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Follow request sent to {}"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"requested"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// DELETE /users/:username/follow — unfollow, or cancel a pending request</span>
<span class="sd">/// (auth required). Always means "stop following / withdraw my request",</span>
<span class="sd">/// so it clears whichever of the two (follows or follow_requests) applies.</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">unfollow_user</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">State</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">AuthUser</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Path</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nb">String</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">FollowResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">target</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">uuid</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"SELECT id FROM users WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER($1)"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">ok_or_else</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">not_found</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="fm">format!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"User '{}' not found"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">)))</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Always clear a pending request, regardless of whether an actual</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// follow also exists (it shouldn't -- a private account only ever has</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// one or the other -- but doing both is harmless and simpler than</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// branching).</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"DELETE FROM follow_requests WHERE requester_id = $1 AND target_id = $2"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to delete follow request"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">begin</span><span class="p">().</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to start transaction"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">was_following</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = $1 AND following_id = $2 RETURNING follower_id"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to unfollow user"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">is_some</span><span class="p">();</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">was_following</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"UPDATE users SET following_count = GREATEST(following_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to update following_count"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"UPDATE users SET follower_count = GREATEST(follower_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to update follower_count"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="s">"DELETE FROM feed_items WHERE user_id = $1 AND post_id IN (SELECT id FROM posts WHERE user_id = $2)"</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">execute</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="k">mut</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to clean up feed_items on unfollow"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">tx</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">commit</span><span class="p">().</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err_ctx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Failed to commit transaction"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">FollowResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">format</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Unfollowed {}"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"not_following"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}))</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// GET /users/me/follow-requests — pending requests to follow *me*</span>
<span class="sd">/// (auth required; only meaningful for a private account, but works</span>
<span class="sd">/// regardless -- a public account just never accumulates any).</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">get_follow_requests</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">State</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">AuthUser</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nb">Vec</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">FollowRequestResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">requests</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_as</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">FollowRequestResponse</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">r#"</span>
<span class="s">        SELECT</span>
<span class="s">            u.id as requester_id,</span>
<span class="s">            u.username as requester_username,</span>
<span class="s">            u.display_name as requester_display_name,</span>
<span class="s">            u.avatar_url as requester_avatar_url,</span>
<span class="s">            fr.created_at</span>
<span class="s">        FROM follow_requests fr</span>
<span class="s">        JOIN users u ON u.id = fr.requester_id</span>
<span class="s">        WHERE fr.target_id = $1</span>
<span class="s">        ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC</span>
<span class="s">        "#</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requests</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">resolve_media</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">storage</span><span class="p">)))</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// POST /users/me/follow-requests/:requester_username/accept (auth required)</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">accept_follow_request</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">State</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">AuthUser</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requester_username</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">Path</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="nb">String</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">-&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Result</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"SELECT id FROM users WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER($1)"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">requester_username</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">ok_or_else</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">||</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">not_found</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="fm">format!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"User '{}' not found"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">requester_username</span><span class="p">)))</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">deleted</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="s">"DELETE FROM follow_requests WHERE requester_id = $1 AND target_id = $2 RETURNING requester_id"</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db_err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Database error"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">deleted</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">is_none</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Err</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AppError</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">not_found</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"No pending request from this user"</span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">establish_follow</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Let the requester know their request was accepted.</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_as</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">crate</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">models</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">UserRow</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1"</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="n">fetch_one</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sqlx</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">query_scalar</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">Uuid</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="s">"INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, type)</span>
<span class="s">             VALUES ($1, $2, 'follow_accepted'::notification_type)</span>
<span class="s">             ON CONFLICT (user_id, actor_id, type, COALESCE(post_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'), COALESCE(comment_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))</span>
<span class="s">             DO NOTHING RETURNING id"</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requester_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">bind</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">auth</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">user_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">fetch_optional</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">db</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">await</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">unwrap_or_default</span><span class="p">();</span>

<span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Some</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">notif_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="kd">let</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">event</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">NotificationEvent</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">target_user_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">requester_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="n">notification</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">NotificationResponse</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">nid</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">type_name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">"follow_accepted"</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">is_read</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">created_at</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">chrono</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">Utc</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">now</span><span class="p">(),</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">post_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">post_thumb_url</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">                    </span><span class="n">actor</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">UserResponse</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">from</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">actor_row</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="w">                </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p">};</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="n">publish_notification</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="k">await</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="w">    </span><span class="nb">Ok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">StatusCode</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="n">NO_CONTENT</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="sd">/// POST /users/me/follow-requests/:requester_username/reject (auth required)</span>
<span class="sd">/// No notification -- same low-key behavior as Instagram; the requester</span>
<span class="sd">/// just never hears back.</span>
<span class="k">pub</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">fn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">reject_follow_request</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="n">State</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">State</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">AppState</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span>
